tyrion-core.description: Tyrion v5.0 built-in 0-token MCP server (10 tools: Universal Auto-Router, Detailed Targeting Accuracy Engine, Meta Audience, Live Meta Insights, Breakdown Effect, Creative Matrix, CAPI/UTM, Spend-Guard, Calculator, Brain Search)

meta-ads.description: Optional live Meta Ads MCP server (github.com/pipeboard-co/meta-ads-mcp). Set META_ACCESS_TOKEN in environment and disabled=false to activate.

google-ads.description: Optional official Google Ads read-only MCP server (github.com/googleads/google-ads-mcp). Set disabled=false after configuring OAuth.
